about: Gate 61 block A18 run alone (CT_G61_ONLY=A18): a thin chess.com account stopped by the month window beside a Lichess account stopped by its 200-game request (the suite's Lichess games stub, which counts its own requests). Graded: both accounts in the list (A18-0c), the stub asked (A18-0a), the two bounds recorded as months and games (A18-0b), and the Review list's limit line naming each cut account with the date its held games reach back to, so it is false for neither (A18a, US-R25; the line reads 'Games back to Aug 1, 2026 for listubuser and Apr 1, 2026 for gateacct1; older ones aren't loaded.' since #549 item (31), Kunal's merge-big answer). Situations by CT_G61_A18_GEO: 375x730 (the block's own), kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31) and 320x568. NOT COVERED: whether the line is whole on screen at 320 (the block reads its text, not its box), a real Lichess response, an account bound by nothing.
